description: A paired benchmark for agentic audio-video generation, review, and localized repair.

tracks.conditioned_song_to_video: Every system receives the same locked song and semantic specification.
tracks.end_to_end_prompt_to_song_video: The system must create audio, visuals, assembly, review, and repair from one request.

cases.prompt: Create a calm illustrated nighttime video about one friendly star above a sleeping village; preserve the star's identity and align each lyric line to a distinct shot.
lyrics: How I wonder what you are
Up above the world so high
Like a diamond in the sky

cases.prompt: Create a playful clock-tower sequence with the same small brown mouse in every shot and visible cause-and-effect movement up and down the clock.
lyrics: The mouse ran up the clock

cases.prompt: Follow two friends in one red boat down a gentle stream, maintaining direction, wardrobe, and boat appearance across shots.
Show a child waiting safely indoors while rain clears, then playing outside; keep clothing and room geography consistent.
Tell a coherent school-day story with the same child and white lamb; use gentle behavior and no frightening imagery.
lyrics: Its fleece was white as snow
The lamb was sure to go

cases.prompt: Create a reassuring fantasy cradle scene with slow movement; reinterpret the ending safely so the cradle settles into glowing clouds.
lyrics: Rock-a-bye baby, on the tree top
When the wind blows, the cradle will rock
When the bough bends, the cradle will glide
Soft into clouds on a moonlit ride

cases.prompt: In one request, write and perform a four-line lullaby about a child and silver rabbit tending a moon garden, then make a coherent 24-second illustrated music video with subtitles.
Produce a gentle four-line synth lullaby and video in which one round blue robot powers down its noisy workshop one machine at a time.
Generate a quiet ocean lullaby and video about the same tiny turtle carrying a lantern home through three distinct underwater locations.
lyrics: Through the blue where bubbles roam

cases.prompt: Create a four-line acoustic lullaby and video where fireflies guide a lost fawn from a fern clearing back to its family without any peril.
lyrics: Light the path where clover grows
Home is where the warm light glows

cases.prompt: Make a dreamy waltz lullaby and video about one cloud train visiting the moon, Saturn, and a comet in that exact order before returning home.
lyrics: Cloud train climbing through the night
Round the rings and past a star

cases.prompt: Generate a slow counting lullaby with synchronized subtitles and shots that visibly introduce exactly one, two, three, then four friendly stars.
lyrics: One small star begins to shine
Three hum low above the door
Close your eyes and dream of four
